audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleed; both missingInteractions (her stun or Tibbers cancels Viktor's R channel; Molten Shield absorbs the burst window) were absent.
audit.why: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1, her Q 4s, W 7s — the stun rebuilds in seconds. Viktor's R is an interruptible channel per his kit flag, so a lit Pyromania is a hard veto on channeling in her 600 range. Molten Shield (10s) absorbs burst and damages attackers, so poking it out first changes the all-in maths.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with numbers; bleed bullets replaced with the Molten Shield force-out rule and the channel-cancel warning.
